name: slicer-fresh-transfer-40960-v1
declared: 2026-11-02, before training or evaluating any model on these two new Slicer settings
scope: Synthetic Slicer settings absent from all earlier declared setting lists; prior runs motivated the question, so the agent and primary cell are selected before seeing these results. Not a real-game or independent-defect validation.
episode_seed_rule: episode e resets with seed (9100 + training_seed) * 100000 + e; greedy or deterministic policy
training_jobs: 4 agents x 7 seeds x (default plus two in-setting references) = 84 new independent training jobs; no trained model weights are reused

primary_comparison.decision: loss if 2,000-resample seed-level bootstrap 95% interval is wholly above 0; gain if wholly below 0; otherwise no measurable difference. Seven seeds per group; descriptive, not equivalence.

secondary_comparisons: Report all other seven agent/setting return gaps, all eight fruit-score gaps, bomb hits, each group mean/interval and per-seed values; unadjusted intervals are descriptive. Do not tune or select after seeing the result.
anchors: Evaluate existing random and scripted policies on each new setting on the same seven evaluation-seed blocks, 30 episodes each; context only.
reproduction_gate: For default-trained seeds 0-4, parameter fingerprints at 20,480 and 40,960 must equal the corresponding committed matched-budget rows before any new-setting comparison is interpreted. New seeds 5-6 and in-setting jobs have no earlier checkpoint reference. Stop interpretation on a mismatch.
